job: Show someone outside the account one result, its measure and the evidence behind it, on a read-only page they open from a link.
purpose: A public page with no app shell: the brand, a Read-only note and Copy link; the result in one line with its measure and a before-and-after strip; how it was counted; what changed and when; drawn screenshots in zoomable frames; a cut of the run log with level filters; the raw response, folded; and who shared it. Expired, switched-off and missing links each get a page state that says when and who.
useWhen: A customer, a manager or a client needs to see that a change worked, without an Ember account.
A figure has to carry its evidence: which runs were counted, what was left out, and the raw data.
A result is shared by link and must stay as it was when it was shared.

avoidWhen.when: The reader is signed in and works with the records: filters, retries, exports.
The page reports the live health of the service rather than one past result.
The page asks the visitor to do one thing, such as sign in or approve.
A person has to decide on the result before it goes anywhere.
